mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner.*, ROWNUM rn FROM ( SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, MEM.MBR_NM, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM BOARD_CARTEGORY BDC JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON BDC.BRD_CTGRY = C.CODE_VALUE WHERE BDC.BRD_CODE = BD.BRD_CODE AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT') AS brdCodeName, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM NOTICE N JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON N.NOTICE_TYPE = C.CODE_VALUE WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'NOTPE') AS noticeTypeName FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD WHERE BD.BRD_CODE = 'S0001' AND BD.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND (BD.BRD_END_DTM IS NULL OR BD.BRD_END_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '002' THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '003' THEN 2 WHEN (SELECT N.NOTICE_TYPE FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = BD.BRD_NO) = '001' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM DESC ) inner WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex} ) WHERE rn >= #{firstRecordIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD BD WHERE BD.BRD_CODE = 'S0001' AND BD.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND (BD.BRD_END_DTM IS NULL OR BD.BRD_END_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
